title: JIALTO 2 Pieces Stainless Steel Broom Holder with Hook - Wall-Mounted Adhesive Waterproof Rustproof Heavy Duty Broom and Mop Stick Holder for Home, Kitchen, Black
bullets: 𝐆𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐞𝐫 : Tired of opening your closet to find a mountain of tools falling in every imaginable direction? Our broom holder could solve this problem and make sure everything stays in place

𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 : Made of high quality SUS 304 stainless steel, waterproof and rustproof. Triangle buckle and petal-shaped gear automatically adjust the size to the different thickness of the handles to prevent the object from slipping.

𝐄𝐀𝐒𝐘 𝐓𝐎 𝐈𝐍𝐒𝐓𝐀𝐋𝐋 : This wall mounted mop broom clip hanger for heavy duty tools is easy and convenient to install. Just stick it to the wall with a strong self-adhesive that will hold your mop firmly in place and protect it from falling.

𝐒𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐞 : The organizers and storage with hooks, save space with its compact size and strong organizational capabilities. It is enough to hang brooms, pugs, rakes, rags, brushes, dustpans, gloves, dusters, baseball bats, etc.

𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫 : perfect for kitchen, closet, garage, office, ideal for commercial use. Thanks to the weatherproof design, this broom mop clothes hanger is even suitable for your garden tools outdoors or in the shed.
